heading: Key Steps in WIL
sub: From classroom to workplace — the stages of a WIL placement.
seo_title: Key Steps in WIL — Pioneer Technical Institute, Iganga Uganda
seo_description: The step-by-step process of a Work-Integrated Learning placement at Pioneer Technical Institute, from preparation to industrial testimonial.
seo_keywords: WIL steps PTI, industrial attachment steps Uganda, work integrated learning process

sections.heading: The Process
list: Step 1 — Readiness: Complete the required core coursework in your department before placement begins.
Step 2 — Matching: Your department head matches you with a suitable partner employer based on your course and location.
Step 3 — Placement: You attend the workplace for the agreed period (minimum 9 months for most trade courses), performing supervised real work.
Step 4 — Check-ins: PTI instructors visit or contact the host periodically to confirm the placement is on track.
Step 5 — Testimonial: The host employer provides a written testimonial evaluating your performance.
Step 6 — Certification: Your placement testimonial is added to your final certification record.
